caveat: South Australian general government sector expenses, GFS annual actual/outcome matrix, by Government Purpose Classification function and economic type. Statewide only; no local government, agency, project or LGA allocation. GPC is mapped explicitly to COFOG; GPC 3450 nominal superannuation interest is a non-COFOG memorandum item and is not published. Every row is one function x economic-type component; parent function totals and the printed TOTAL row are never emitted, and no cross-function/year/source total is created.
measure_basis: GFS annual actual/outcome matrix; the workbook has no budget/actual column
notes: Derived rows only; workbook not redistributed. Parent Total GPC and printed TOTAL rows are never emitted. GPC 3450 is a non-COFOG memorandum item and is not published. Every row is a function x economic-type component; no cross-function/year/source total is created.
